description:
• Brand introduction: We promote eye health by making eye drops easier, safer, and more affordable with our eye drop adapter.
• Product description: The Precision Dropper is an adapter that makes putting in eye drops easier than ever before by giving you total control of the drops and removing the need to tilt your head back.
• USP (Unique Selling Point): Created and trusted by doctors. Improved ease of use and safety while saving money. No tears or ruined makeup.
• Payment terms: 10% of sales generated through your affiliate link.

Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).
